output_text: Guidance for AI agents contributing to `umami-kotlin` repo. Kotlin Multiplatform library wrapper for Umami REST API, providing type-safe async easy use. Modules: `:umami`, `:sample:simple-compose-app`, `:sample:terminalApp`. `:umami` packages: `api` (REST comm), `core` (HTTP client + event queue), `domain` (models/value objects e.g., `Hostname`, `Ip`). Tech: Ktor for HTTP, multiplatform engines (e.g., `OkHttp` Android/JVM, `Darwin` iOS); Kotlinx Coroutines for async/event queue; Kotlinx Serialization for JSON; `kotlin.time.Instant` for time type safety; Kermit logging; Kotest for assertions (use Kotest matchers like `shouldBe`, not `kotlin.test`); Mokkery for mocks; `UmamiOptionsBuilder` (Builder); `Umami` facade; Channel producer-consumer queue sending events in background coroutine to API. Follow [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) and [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Project: Gradle; IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA CE or Android Studio.
